name: causal-conv1d
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: causal-conv1d
  version: "1.6.2.post1"
  build_number: 7

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/Dao-AILab/${{ name }}/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 4589196e0afd58a015f32dd7333183e1bb582c928d0a333496b6ec86f462012d

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  string: ${{ "cuda" ~ (cuda_compiler_version | replace(".", "")) ~ "py" ~ (python | version_to_buildstring) ~ "h" ~ hash ~ "_" ~ build_number }}
  # Upstream only provides a CUDA extension. CUDA 11.8 is outside this
  # feedstock's current PyTorch CUDA matrix.
  skip:
    - cuda_compiler_version == "None" or cuda_compiler_version == "11.8"
    # PyTorch 2.13's Windows CUDA 12 build is pinned to CUDA 12.8, while the
    # conda-forge compiler matrix currently provides 12.9 and 13.0 here.
    - win and cuda_compiler_version != "13.0"
  script:
    - if: unix
      then:
        - export CAUSAL_CONV1D_FORCE_BUILD=TRUE
        - export CAUSAL_CONV1D_FORCE_CXX11_ABI=TRUE
        - export CUDA_HOME="${BUILD_PREFIX}"
    - if: win
      then:
        - set CAUSAL_CONV1D_FORCE_BUILD=TRUE
    - sed -i.bak 's@"ninja"@#"ninja"@g' setup.py
    - sed -i 's@"--threads", "4"@"--threads", "1"@g' setup.py
    - python -m build --wheel --no-isolation --skip-dependency-check .
    - if: unix
      then: python -m pip install dist/causal_conv1d-*.whl --no-deps -vv
    # cmd.exe does not expand wildcard arguments, so enumerate the wheel in
    # the generated batch script before passing its concrete path to pip.
    - if: win
      then: for %%f in (dist\causal_conv1d-*.whl) do python -m pip install "%%f" --no-deps -vv
  prefix_detection:
    ignore:
      - x86_64-conda-linux-gnu/lib/libgfortran.so*
      - lib/gcc/x86_64-conda-linux-gnu/*/libhwasan.so

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: ${{ compiler("cuda") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython
        - python
        - "pytorch ${{ pytorch }}.* *cuda*"
    - if: unix
      then: sed
    - if: win
      then: m2-sed
  host:
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - cuda-version ==${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
    # PyTorch compiles the C++ binding against CUDA headers in the host prefix.
    # On Windows, cuda-cudart-dev does not include crt/host_defines.h.
    - if: win
      then: cuda-crt-dev_${{ target_platform }}
    - ninja
    - packaging
    - pip
    - python
    - python-build
    - "pytorch ${{ pytorch }}.* *cuda*"
    - setuptools >=18.0
    - wheel
  run:
    - ${{ pin_compatible("python") }}
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: cuda-cudart
    - packaging
    - python
    - python_abi * *_cp${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}
    - "pytorch ${{ pytorch }}.* *cuda*"
  ignore_run_exports:
    from_package:
      - packaging

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - causal_conv1d
      pip_check: true

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/Dao-AILab/causal-conv1d
  summary: Causal depthwise conv1d in CUDA, with a PyTorch interface
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  feedstock-name: causal-conv1d
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jeongseok-meta
